base_value_source: 01_historical-financials.md §1 (FY2026 EBITDA); Oracle Corporation NYSE ORCL Financials_Annual.xls, Income Statement tab — Capital IQ, data as of 2026-08-13 (not separately disclosed by Oracle itself)

sensitivities.label: AI-infrastructure customer/counterparty concentration pullback (% of implied 12-month cRPO)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Asymmetric and lumpy: no quantified upside beyond the OCI-conversion-pace variable; concentrated in 4 customers each contracting >$8B in a single quarter (named: AMD, Meta, NVIDIA, OpenAI, TikTok, xAI), so a pullback from one counterparty could clear much of this range on its own rather than moving smoothly with %.
sensitivities.source: business-model/10_external-dependency.md §5 (20% stress test); FY26 10-K, Item 7 MD&A, p.55 (RPO conversion schedule, implied ~$76.6B 12-month cRPO)

sensitivities.label: Consolidated gross margin (cost-of-revenue ratio) change
sensitivities.non_linearity: Management guides FY2027 gross margin to 'step down' further due to a data-center capex-to-revenue timing lag (cost recognized before contracted revenue ramps, lag unquantified in quarters) — downside moves are directionally more likely near-term than upside per guidance.

sensitivities.label: USD vs foreign-currency basket, % change in FX rates
sensitivities.non_linearity: Oracle's FX-forward hedging program 'may not fully offset' currency moves [FY26 10-K, Item 1A, p.19]; disclosed sensitivity is linear at ±10%, not tested by the company beyond that band.
sensitivities.source: FY26 10-K, Item 7A, Sensitivity Analysis table, p.56

sensitivities.label: Combined S&M + R&D + G&A ratio-of-revenue change
sensitivities.non_linearity: Blended coefficient across three lines with different flex — S&M/G&A are more variable, R&D is constrained by product/competitive needs — the combined rate does not separate them.

sensitivities.label: Cloud infrastructure (OCI) revenue / RPO conversion pace, incremental USD
sensitivities.non_linearity: OCI is currently supply-constrained (97.5% GPU utilization, 98% of AI datacenter capacity already contracted per Q4 FY26 transcript) — near-term upside is capped by build-out speed, not demand; downside is uncapped if a named large customer pulls back (see ai_customer_concentration_pullback_pct).

sensitivities.label: Rate on ~$20B assumed new FY2027 debt issuance
sensitivities.non_linearity: Applies only to new debt issued at FY2027 market rates, not the existing $129.5B stock, which is largely fixed-rate at issuance (only one $500M floating-rate tranche identified) and insulated from rate moves until refinanced. A credit-rating downgrade would compound this by raising the base rate AND, per the 10-K, could 'limit eligibility to contract with certain customers' — a direct link from financing cost to revenue.
